SHARE_API_SECRET.description: Optional secret key for securing the snapshot sharing API endpoint. If set, requests to /api/share must include Authorization: Bearer <secret> header.

BLOB_STORE_ID.description: Vercel Blob storage ID for the snapshots store. Create a private blob store in Vercel dashboard.

BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN.description: Vercel Blob read/write token for authentication. Generate this in Vercel dashboard.
